0022600172.text: The Lakers (5-2, 1st in the Pacific, 4th in the West) host the Miami Heat (2-4, 4th in the Southeast, 10th in the East) in the Lakers' eighth game of the 2026-27 season, coming in on a one-game winning streak with a 3-1 home record. Miami has won its last two games, and its 1-3 home mark is the weakest part of its record so far. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Lakers won both games of their 2025-26 series 2-0, including a 134-126 win in Miami on March 19, 2026, and Adou Thiero is out for the Lakers with knee inflammation.
